mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900,000 units in the prior month, it signals strong consumer confidence and increased disposable income, leading to higher corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where HOUST exceeds 900,000 units, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages indicates a robust consumer demand cycle, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the joint RSAFS and HOUST interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both series are above their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2 percentage points over the past month signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines >0.2pp in a month and UNRATE > 7.5% at the time of the signal, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 98.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has been below 98.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and an increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annually signals a central bank's attempt to stimulate the economy, which typically leads to positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher growth.
regime_hint: monetary policy easing with inflation concerns
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the joint FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both conditions hold.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market, which drives higher consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has increased for at least 6 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 99.0), a decline in industrial production by more than 0.5% over the past month signals a contraction in the supply chain, which reduces corporate output and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines >0.5% in a month and INDPRO < 99.0 at the time of the signal, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
